name: Trait Catalog
description: Mutation trait catalog split by $(reset)pure-positive / dual-edge$(reset) (45 benign / 12 dual), each listed with stats and passives sorted by rarity and design intent (Strike / Ward / Glide); about half are $(reset)slot-bound$(reset), only appearing on organs of the matching body slot.$(br)Traits are not bound to any genome — every breed draws from the same pool.
